name: PayPal Agent Toolkit
description: Wires PayPal payments, invoices, disputes, subscriptions, and shipment tracking into agents through an MCP server and packages for the major agent frameworks.

skills.name: Invoice Management
skills.description: Creates, sends, and tracks PayPal invoices, including reminders and payment status for each outstanding item.

skills.name: Dispute Handling
skills.description: Lists open disputes and submits evidence or responses against them from inside an agent workflow.

skills.name: Subscription Billing
skills.description: Manages subscription plans and active subscriptions, covering creation, updates, and cancellation.
